collection.title: Skoda Roomster 2014 to 2016 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Skoda Roomster 2014 to 2016 requires a 21" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Roomster which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
